name: MemoryPlugin
description:
MemoryPlugin gives Claude a permanent memory that you keep: facts about you, your work, and your preferences, organized in buckets you control. Tell Claude something once, and it's there in your next conversation, and in whichever AI you open next.

What you can do:
- Store memories from any conversation and recall them when they matter.
- Search your full chat history synced into MemoryPlugin from your AI apps, and pull past conversations into today's context.
- Search files you've uploaded to your memory buckets.
- Keep everything organized in buckets (work, personal, projects) that you manage from the MemoryPlugin dashboard.

Add a memory while talking to Claude, and every other tool connected to your MemoryPlugin account has it from your next conversation. MemoryPlugin has been building AI memory since 2024, longer than most native memory features have existed.

Requires a MemoryPlugin account. New accounts start with a free 7-day trial.

_published_faq.name: How do I add MemoryPlugin to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add MemoryPlugin to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.memoryplugin.com/api/mcp/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the MemoryPlugin MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: MemoryPlugin lists 14 MCP tools, including chat_history_overview, create_bucket, export_conversation, get_conversation_summary, get_full_conversation, get_memories_and_buckets, list_bucket_categories, list_buckets, list_category_memories, recall_chat_history, search_memories, and search_uploaded_files.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to MemoryPlugin?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to MemoryPlugin in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
MemoryPlugin requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
MemoryPlugin is developed by MemoryPlugin. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
